454.text: Two ladies , whom Philip did not know

497.text: a room on the floor below

quotes.text: "You'd better put him back in his own bed."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "What will happen to him, poor child?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Was it a girl or a boy?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "I don't think there's anything I can do just now,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "You've sent for Mrs. Carey's brother-in-law, haven't you?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "D'you know at what time he'll be here?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "What about the little boy? I should think he'd be better out of the way."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Miss Watkin said she'd take him, sir."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "She's his godmother, sir. D'you think Mrs. Carey will get over it, sir?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "You naughty boy, Miss Watkin WILL be cross with you."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Aren't you going to ask how your mamma is?"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Your mamma is quite well and happy."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Your mamma's gone away. You won't ever see her any more."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Your Uncle William is waiting in to see you,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"Go and say
good-bye to Miss Watkin, and we'll go home."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Very well, run upstairs and get your hat."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "I think I'll go and say good-bye to Miss Watkin."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Go in and tell them I'm coming,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Master Philip wants to say good-bye to you, miss."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"His mother was my greatest friend. I can't bear to think that she's
dead."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "You oughtn't to have gone to the funeral, Henrietta,"
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text:
"Poor little boy, it's dreadful to think of him quite alone in the world.
I see he limps."
quotes.speaker: Unknown

quotes.text: "Yes, he's got a club-foot. It was such a grief to his mother."
quotes.speaker: Unknown
